sources.label: Official Gymshark women's size guide (tops + bottoms)

audit: Gymshark's own support-site guide. Chest and waist from the Women's Tops chart; hips from the Women's Bottoms chart (same letter sizes, identical waist figures). UK/US/EU from the tops chart. Note Gymshark's bottoms chart gives US one step higher (XXS = US 2-4 vs 0-2 for tops); the tops US is used. Stored values already matched the official chart; re-confirmed, no number changes.
